tasks.title: Panel shell: navigation and the who-am-I page
tasks.goal: The panel layout from js/ui-kit: navigation entries registered by modules with the permission each needs, through laravel-console-kit if T20's evaluation adopted it, else a registry in the panel module. An entry is shown only when the actor holds its permission on some node. The start page. The query actor.me version 1, with a schema and a generated codec (T21), on surfaces rest and inertia. It gives the principal's actor id, class, state, its own profile, and its grants with role handle, node, effect and locales. A subject always reads its own profile regardless of classification access, and actor.me is not ReadsContent, which is recorded under Tolkninger. It is allowed for every actor principal without a permission, a new rule in the query authorizer kept to queries marked as self-reads; the anonymous principal is unauthorized. Inertia pages that read get their props from the QueryPipeline with the session credential and the query's result codec. SurfaceParityTest also covers query pages, so an Inertia query page without a REST route fails; T21's Inertia query profile gains its cases. These are check changes, logged. Part 1 shows parity on REST with a Bearer service credential. A person reaches REST with personal API tokens in part 2, recorded under Tolkninger. The who-am-I page shows name, email, actor id, class and the grants. Docs: docs/addons/panel-pages.md (pages and navigation entries with their permissions, with a running example), and a recipe in docs/recipes for 'add a panel page'. Built on the panel extension architecture (cms-planning/proposals/panel-extension-architecture.md, accepted 2 October 2026): every component from js/ui-kit, the page hosts its declared panel points with the core's own contributions in the cms namespace, WCAG 2.2 AA with axe in its browser test, and its screenshot in docs.

tasks.title: Command palette built from the action registry
tasks.goal: GUARDRAILS 8 'Tastaturet først'. The query action.list version 1 (schema and codec, surfaces rest and inertia, allowed for every actor principal) gives, from the compiled registry, every action exposed on Inertia whose permission the actor holds on some node (PermissionRule over the actor's grants). Each entry has name, version, kind, and the title and description from its JSON Schema, plus T13's navigation entries the actor may open. The palette in js/ui-kit and js/panel opens with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K from every panel page and filters as one types. It is an accessible combobox (ARIA roles, focus trap, Escape closes) that navigates with the arrow keys and Enter: a page entry navigates, and a command entry opens the command's form page, which T15 fills with the generic form. No action, type or field is named in the palette's code. Browser tests get their grants from the testkit's PostgresAccessFixtures inside the test, because the grant commands come in T16. Built on the panel extension architecture (cms-planning/proposals/panel-extension-architecture.md, accepted 2 October 2026): every component from js/ui-kit, the page hosts its declared panel points with the core's own contributions in the cms namespace, WCAG 2.2 AA with axe in its browser test, and its screenshot in docs.

tasks.title: Generic command form from the command's JSON Schema
tasks.goal: So every command the palette offers can be run with the keyboard. A form renderer in js/ui-kit and js/panel is driven by the command's JSON Schema. It supports the subset the kernel's command schemas use: strings with patterns and lengths, integers with bounds, booleans, enums, nullable members, defaults, nested objects, arrays of objects, and the FieldValues member as a JSON editor checked by the generated runtime validator. Any other keyword is an explicit unsupported-keyword error. The form validates in the browser with the generated TypeScript validator before it submits, and submits through the Inertia profile with an idempotency key per form instance, an optional dry run, and the wait level. It shows the receipt's outcome and, for a rejection, each error at its field from the errors prop. Labels come from the schema's title and description, translated when the catalogue has the key, and the form names no command. Docs: a recipe in docs/recipes for 'expose a command in the panel'. Built on the panel extension architecture (cms-planning/proposals/panel-extension-architecture.md, accepted 2 October 2026): every component from js/ui-kit, the page hosts its declared panel points with the core's own contributions in the cms namespace, WCAG 2.2 AA with axe in its browser test, and its screenshot in docs.

tasks.title: Roles and grants in the panel
tasks.goal: Panel pages reachable from the navigation and the palette. Roles: list (role.list), create with role.create, and edit permissions with role.set_permissions. Grants: list (grant.list), assign with pickers for actor (actor.list), role, node (node.list), effect and locales through grant.assign, and revoke through grant.revoke. Each page shows the receipt's outcome, and a refusal by the guard (grant_escalation_refused, step_up_required) with its translated message. Each has empty, loading and failing states. A newly assigned grant appears in the list and on the who-am-I page of its actor. tasks.title: Workbench login path, getting-started docs and the part 1 exit browser test
tasks.goal: Make the documented path real. composer dev:prepare also runs cms:install, cms:sites:sync and composer panel:build through the dev image, each idempotent. Add composer workbench:serve, which serves the workbench in a dev-image container of the checkout with a published port (127.0.0.1:8080 by default, through DevImageRun with a port option, reaching Postgres and Valkey as the gates do), with a test using the fake docker. compose.yaml's php service is left unchanged. Add a page in docs/getting-started that says how to start the services, prepare the dev database, create the first staff member with cms:staff:create, grant access with cms:access:bootstrap on the workbench site's root node, serve the workbench, open http://127.0.0.1:8080/cms and log in. It embeds running examples where gate 10 needs them and gets a screenshot entry if the page warrants one. Add docs/users/_index.md and a first page for people who log in to the panel. The scripted part of the path is tests/Postgres/GettingStartedPathTest.php: dev:prepare's steps twice, with the second run changing nothing; cms:staff:create; cms:access:bootstrap; then an HTTP login against the served application and a request to the who-am-I page. Following the page by hand in a browser stays manual. The exit browser test is tests/Browser/Panel/StaffJourneyTest.php. A local staff member, created through cms:staff:create's action and bootstrapped, logs in, opens the command palette with the keyboard, assigns a non-administrative role to a second staff member, sees the grant, and logs out, with the shared page assertions at each page. Record B1 part 1 in PROGRESS.md 'Seneste kørsel' only through the merge queue. Built on the panel extension architecture (cms-planning/proposals/panel-extension-architecture.md, accepted 2 October 2026): every component from js/ui-kit, the page hosts its declared panel points with the core's own contributions in the cms namespace, WCAG 2.2 AA with axe in its browser test, and its screenshot in docs.
